qa_pairs.question: Which component uses M51/M41 screws and requires 2.5 Nm torque?
qa_pairs.answer: Electr. line on fuel cutout device

qa_pairs.question: What is the tolerance range for the electric shutoff to injection pump torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The specification is 20 ± 5 Nm, giving a range of 15-25 Nm
